text: Our return policy allows you to return products that are undamaged and complete. You can try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need the order number for the return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, returns are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. Return shipping is free if you use our contracted carrier, Anadolu Kargo, and show the return code at the branch. If you use your own carrier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. Once the product reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN.
